children: Goodwin said it agreed to sell a substantial portion of its mechanical engineering division to an affiliate of Cerberus Capital Management for up to 1.1 billion pounds ($1.49 billion) in cash, as part of an effort to narrow the group's focus.

The engineering company said the division includes Goodwin Steel Castings Limited, Goodwin International Limited, Noreva GmbH, Easat Group and the Pumps Division. Cerberus is an investor with significant relevant industry experience, Goodwin said.
The deal is expected to complete in the first quarter of 2027, according to Goodwin. It will create a more focused group that has more capacity to invest in other parts of the business, it said.
"We are confident of continued success and growth in our remaining businesses," said Chairman Timothy J. W. Goodwin.
